title: Fix failing build and implement advanced analytics aggregations (top-selling, top-searched, net profit by period)

requirements.text: Investigate and fix the current build/deploy failure so the project compiles and deploys successfully again.
acceptanceCriteria: A clean build completes without errors for both backend and frontend.
A deploy completes successfully and the app loads without runtime errors.
Any fixes are captured in code (no manual post-build steps required).

requirements.text: Implement backend aggregation methods required for advanced analytics: (1) top-selling products, (2) most-searched products, and (3) net profit grouped by time period.

quotes: ok quiero que las agreges. porque quiero el programa completamente funcional

Las funciones de análisis avanzado (productos más vendidos, productos más buscados, ganancia neta por período) estarán disponibles una vez que se implementen métodos adicionales de agregación en el backend.

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes query methods to return top-selling products (ranked by quantity sold) with a configurable limit and an optional time range filter.
Backend tracks product search activity and exposes a query method to return most-searched products (ranked by search count) with a configurable limit and an optional time range filter.

Backend exposes a query method that returns net profit grouped by a requested period (e.g., day/week/month) for a requested time range; profit is computed from recorded sales data (revenue minus cost).
All analytics methods enforce the same access-control level as other user-facing read operations (i.e., require at least user permission).
Existing functionality (inventory CRUD, sales posting, search, cashbox, customers) continues to work unchanged.

requirements.text: Update the frontend to consume and display the new advanced analytics on the Dashboard (top-selling products, most-searched products, and net profit by period), with sensible loading/empty states.

quotes: ok quiero que las agreges. porque quiero el programa completamente funcional

Las funciones de análisis avanzado (productos más vendidos, productos más buscados, ganancia neta por período) estarán disponibles una vez que se implementen métodos adicionales de agregación en el backend.

acceptanceCriteria: React Query hooks are added in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts for each new backend analytics method.
Dashboard page (frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx) renders sections/cards for: top-selling products, most-searched products, and net profit by period.
Dashboard supports selecting a time range/period grouping (at minimum: a few preset ranges such as last 7 days / last 30 days / this month) and updates analytics accordingly.
All new user-visible UI strings use the existing i18n helper (t(...)) and do not introduce hard-coded English/Spanish strings in components.

requirements.text: Update backend search behavior to record search events needed for “most-searched products” analytics without breaking current search results.
acceptanceCriteria: Product searches continue to return the same matching inventory items as before.
Each successful search increments stored counters needed to compute “most-searched products” (counts per product), without requiring any external services or databases.
Search tracking storage is bounded or otherwise managed to avoid unbounded growth (e.g., store per-product counters rather than logging every query verbatim).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any frontend paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Use English for any user-facing text in this build request document (implementation can continue using the app’s existing Spanish i18n system).
nonGoals: Implementing a full accounting/ledger system or advanced BI features beyond the three requested analytics.
Adding external databases, third-party analytics services, or off-chain storage.
Real-time dashboards or push-based updates (polling via React Query is sufficient).
